Connecting any device to any network

Products Learn about CRA
Link copied!

Any device

Under the Anybus brand, HMS offers a comprehensive range of products that ensure safe and fast industrial communication for any device – Wired or wirelessly. 

Anybus also provides products and services that offer insights into your industrial networks, ensuring their health and reliability.

Any network

Anybus products allow you to connect to any major fieldbus or Industrial Ethernet, or IIoT network, including PROFINET, PROFIBUS, EtherNet/IP, DeviceNet, CAN/CANopen, CC-Link, CC-Link IE Field, CC-Link IE TSN, Modbus (RTU and TCP), EtherCAT, BACnet, POWERLINK, OPC UA, and MQTT.

See how our solutions solve your connectivity challenges

Embedded network solutions

Need to add a built-in communication interface into your device? Then read more about our embedded solutions. We can connect any device to any industrial network. Plus, we’ll provide expert guidance to ensure the process goes smoothly.

Gateways for manufacturers

Want to connect your machine or device to any network without changing your hardware or software? See how our Anybus Gateways offer a plug-and-play solution that makes it easy to expand your market and increase security, whatever your application.

Gateways on the factory floor

Need to integrate a new machine, connect legacy equipment, or segment your network? Whatever the issue, our gateways can help. See how our gateways solve connectivity issues on the factory floor quickly and easily.

Industrial wireless

Are you suffering from broken cables? Or is installing new cabling too complex or expensive? See how our wireless products and services provide a reliable alternative.

Functional safety

Need to connect to safety networks like PROFIsafe, CIP Safety, or FSoE? Our solutions make it easy to add functional safety to your industrial systems.

Network diagnostics

Make sure your network never goes down! Network uptime and security is assured with Anybus Diagnostics and services.

PC Interfaces

Easily connect your PC to any industrial Ethernet network. INpact PC interfaces provide a simple, flexible way to integrate PC-based applications across all major networks.

Industrial Network Security

Protect critical systems and reduce downtime with effective OT segmentation. Secure industrial networks by limiting risk and containing threats.
